question: If the compound interest on a certain sum at 16frac23 per annum for 3 years is ₹1270, find the simple interest on the same sum at the same rate and for the same period.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Rate = 16 2/3% = 1/6.

Let Principal = 6³ = 216 units.

Amount after 3 years = 7³ = 343 units ⇒ CI = 343 − 216 = 127 units.

Given CI = ₹1270 ⇒ 127 units = 1270 ⇒ 1 unit = ₹10.

SI for 3 years = 216 × (1/6) × 3 = 108 units = 108 × 10 = ₹1080.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1080.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Rate (R) = 16 2/3% = 50/3% per annum

Time (T) = 3 years

Compound Interest (CI) = ₹1270

**Formula Used:**

Amount (A) = P × (1 + R/100)T

CI = A − P

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100
